forecast.seedPolicy: fixed-per-game: hash(providerEventId); draw i uses mulberry32(fnv1a32(seed + ':' + i))

engine.structure: shared-pace team scoring → quarter split → overtime → player allocation
engine.seedPolicy: fixed-per-game: hash(providerEventId); draw i uses mulberry32(fnv1a32(seed + ':' + i))
engine.otCapRule: at most 8 OT periods; a tied 8th period is redrawn until untied (rejection, counted in notes.otCapRedraws)

sim.tieRule: overtime resolves every regulation tie (5-minute periods until untied; cap rule in engine.otCapRule)

representativeSamples.label: typical
representativeSamples.selectionRule: draw minimising ((margin−p50 margin)/sd margin)² + ((total−p50 total)/sd total)²; ties → lowest runIndex

representativeSamples.label: close
representativeSamples.selectionRule: among draws with the smallest |final margin| (1), the one whose total is nearest p50 total; ties → lowest runIndex

representativeSamples.label: high
representativeSamples.selectionRule: draw whose total is nearest the 95th-percentile total (243), then margin nearest p50 margin; ties → lowest runIndex

representativeSamples.label: low
representativeSamples.selectionRule: draw whose total is nearest the 5th-percentile total (185), then margin nearest p50 margin; ties → lowest runIndex

representativeSamples.label: upset
representativeSamples.selectionRule: the sim underdog (away, pHome 0.6145) wins in 3855 draws; among them, the draw nearest their median (margin, total) in sd units; ties → lowest runIndex

home.source: roster rows (availability re-read from the injuries feed under the current team)
home.rule: status contains 'Out' → excluded; Day-To-Day and unlisted → simulated (injuryStatus recorded per player so boards can exclude Day-To-Day)

away.source: roster rows (availability re-read from the injuries feed under the current team)
away.rule: status contains 'Out' → excluded; Day-To-Day and unlisted → simulated (injuryStatus recorded per player so boards can exclude Day-To-Day)

home.rule: per draw: Bernoulli(playRate) × N(mean, sd) clipped [0,48], water-filled to 240 + 25·OT with cap 48 + 5·OT

away.rule: per draw: Bernoulli(playRate) × N(mean, sd) clipped [0,48], water-filled to 240 + 25·OT with cap 48 + 5·OT
